name: unity
description: Unity for coding agents: batch-mode compile, method runs and tests, terrain from data, screenshots. Kits are source copied into the project.

interface.shortDescription: Compile, test, build terrain and capture Unity projects unattended
interface.longDescription: Install small source kits into a Unity project: a batch-mode driver that reports compile errors and test results, an editor script that renders a camera to a PNG, and a terrain builder that turns a layout written as data into a Terrain with paint layers. Every install is planned first and never overwrites a file you changed.
defaultPrompt: Use $gam3stack-unity-kits to add the batch driver to this Unity project.
Use $unity-batch-loop to check that this project compiles and its tests pass.
Use $unity-worlds to build a terrain with a road from a layout and show me a screenshot.
